castle.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castle.position: A fortress perched on a rocky spur, with a dominant view over the valley.
castle.defense: Loopholes, thick walls, and patrol walkways tell of its defensive function.
castle.conspiracy: Secret rooms and noble chambers were the scene of medieval conspiracies and intrigues.
castle.prisons: The underground prisons still hold the traces of ancient detentions.
castle.legend_brothers: The legend of the two brothers tells of a fatal duel for the love of a lady.
castle.leading_para: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley as a millenary strategic bulwark.
castle.para_2: Every corner of this manor exudes charm and mystery: from the famous Conspiracy Hall, scene of intrigues and pactes between medieval nobles, to the ancient Inquisition prisons carved into the stone.
castle.para_3: Between history and legend, the spirit of Sister Felicia still protects the village. The Castellana awaits you in chat to reveal every secret of this timeless place.
castle.welcomemsg_felicia: Welcome to the Castle of Caccamo, stranger. I am Sister Felicia. Would you like me to reveal the secrets of the Conspiracy Hall or would you prefer to listen to the ancient legends of the manor? Just ask me.

castello.title: The Castle of Caccamo
castello.description: The Castle of Caccamo is among the largest and best-preserved Norman fortresses in Sicily. Perched on the living rock since the 11th century, it dominates the San Leonardo valley with its imposing walls, watchtowers, and suggestive internal halls that evoke centuries of feudal history and chivalric legends.

badia.title: Church of San Benedetto alla Badia
badia.description: A true jewel of Sicilian Baroque, the church is famous worldwide for its extraordinary floor entirely made of 18th-century maiolica, depicting allegorical scenes and naturalistic motifs of rare mastery. A masterpiece of visual art suspended in time.
badia.hours: Tue - Sun: 09:00 – 12:30 | Mon: 14:30 – 18:30 (No regular service, ideal for visits)
badia.tickets: Full € 2.00 | Reduced € 1.00 (EU Youth 18-25 years or with Castle ticket same day) | Free under 18

santamaria.title: Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli
santamaria.description: Founded in the 15th century together with the Dominican convent, the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli is one of the most important spiritual centers of the village. It houses the remains and relics of Blessed Giovanni Liccio, Patron of Caccamo. Inside, you can admire splendid marble altars and sacred art pieces that testify to centuries of deep devotion and pilgrimages.
santamaria.hours: Opening and Visits: Saturday from 16:00 to 17:30 | Sunday from 09:00 to 10:00 and from 11:00 to 12:30. (Holy Masses: Saturday 17:30 | Sunday 10:00).

sangiorgio.title: Church of San Giorgio Martire
sangiorgio.description: The Mother Church of Caccamo, dedicated to San Giorgio Martire, is an imposing masterpiece that dominates the monumental square below the Castle. Founded in the Norman era and rebuilt in 1614, it preserves an immense artistic heritage: from Gaginiano school sculptures to precious 17th-century canvases by the Flemish painter Matthias Stom, up to the rich chapels decorated in mixed marbles.
sangiorgio.hours: Visit Time Slots: Saturday and Sunday 09:30 – 10:45 and 16:00 – 18:00. (Tourist reception is suspended during the Sunday Holy Mass at 11:00).

annunziata.title: SS. Annunziata Parish
annunziata.description: Nestled within the medieval urban fabric, the church stands out for its facade and for the atmosphere of deep spirituality inside. It preserves finely decorated altars and artistic artifacts that attract visitors and faithful alike.
annunziata.hours: Mon - Sat: 09:00 – 12:00 | Weekday Masses at 18:00. Sunday and Holidays visits in the slots: 08:30 - 09:30 and 10:30 - 12:00 (Festive Masses at 09:30, 12:00, 19:00).

cappuccini.title: Convent of the Capuchin Friars
cappuccini.description: A place of silence, meditation, and history, the structures of the Convent are deeply linked to the Franciscan tradition in Sicily. In addition to the convent structure, the area offers an authentic glimpse of monastic life and popular devotion.
cappuccini.hours: Accessible mainly on request or during Franciscan anniversaries. Contact the Tourism Office.
cappuccini.secret_info: 💡 The Hidden Jewels of Caccamo: The village is home to no less than 33 churches. Use the Din Don Dan map and zoom in on Caccamo to discover real-time opening hours of lesser-known treasures like the Church of San Rocco and other small widespread masterpieces.
